Friction values must never be invented to fill this gap.

existing_evidence_in_repo.status_of_that_evidence: Campaign-scoped economic verification of SESSION_TRADE_V2 (a rejected candidate). It is NOT a repository-level friction authority for new candidates: it is broker-published/marketplace-sourced for FX majors (2026-era quotes applied to 2017 data) and measured-spread only for XAUUSD. Any future NET claim requires its own preregistered friction authority meeting the contract below.

EURUSD.spread: REQUIRED — time-of-day distribution (median + p75 + p95) from the execution venue or a measured tick/bid-ask archive contemporaneous with the evaluation window; venue name + retrieval date + raw bytes hash
EURUSD.slippage: REQUIRED — per-side, measured or conservatively bounded, with method
EURUSD.commission: REQUIRED — round-turn USD per notional unit, venue schedule reference
EURUSD.partial_exit_treatment: REQUIRED — how fractional exits at the first objective are charged (pro-rata spread/slippage per fill)
EURUSD.runner_exit_treatment: REQUIRED — how the runner leg exit (target/stop/horizon close) is charged, including stop-gap risk on M15 close exits
EURUSD.forced_or_horizon_close_treatment: REQUIRED — charge model for the 96-bar horizon close (market order at last completed M15 close)
EURUSD.swap_rollover_applicability: REQUIRED — position holding times are intraday (max 24h); state whether swap applies and, if so, the schedule

required_evidence_contract_per_symbol.XAUUSD: same contract as EURUSD, plus: contract size (100 oz) notional handling and any metal-specific financing

acceptance_rules: Every friction value must carry provenance: source name, URL or dataset, retrieval/measurement date, and a hash of the raw evidence bytes.
Measured spreads contemporaneous with the evaluation window outrank current broker-published quotes; 2026 quotes applied to 2017 data are ADVISORY ONLY.
Conservative direction: when in doubt, round costs AGAINST the candidate.
The authority must be preregistered BEFORE any OOS window is opened for an economic claim (structural claims may proceed without it, reporting ECONOMIC_METRICS=NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_FRICTION_AUTHORITY).
No broker data may be collected inside a consolidation mission; this record is the prepared data contract only.
